description: Every 15 minutes, checks for patients who were offered reschedule times and watches the same email thread for their reply. Reads the full reply (not just Graph's short preview), trims the quoted original message off before matching, and uses AI to figure out which time was picked, moves the Cliniko booking, and sends a confirmation. An unclear reply is flagged for a human instead of guessed — this never books a time it isn't confident about.

flowIr.description: Polls for pending reschedule offers, matches a patient's full reply to one of the proposed times via AI, moves the Cliniko booking, and confirms — or flags for a human when the reply is unclear.
flowIr.name: Cliniko Automations: Apply patient's chosen reschedule time
